rows.note: Use this as the everyday noun for the occupation or work of being in a bank.

example.english: I've been doing banking work for five years.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 zo2 ngan4 hong4 gung1 zok3 ng5 nin4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the business or practice of managing a bank, rather than merely working there.

example.english: Banking management isn't just about looking at figures.
example.traditional: 銀行管理唔係淨係睇數。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 gun2 lei5 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 tai2 sou3

rows.jyutping: tau4 zi1 ngan4 hong4 jip6 mou6
rows.note: Use this for investment banking as a professional business or career area.

example.english: I want to go into investment banking.
example.traditional: 我想投身投資銀行業務。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tau4 san1 tau4 zi1 ngan4 hong4 jip6 mou6
